593:t_018:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$! We'll protect you!!」

593:t_022:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not just that... It's $$マリーダ$$'s... everyone's... sorrow.」

593:t_022:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! How could you, you...!!」

593:t_022:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「He has no more... hostility...」

593:t_022:8.en:
$$カツ$$
「That doesn't excuse something like this!」

593:t_022:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「It's been painful for you too, hasn't it...」

593:t_022:12.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Master... Father... chose to cast off hatred... for the sake of... the future...」

593:t_022:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That person's... light... saves me... from sinking... into hatred...」

593:t_022:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm sorry...! I... the person I was then...!!」

593:t_023:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「Why... did it come to this...」

593:t_024:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Why...? With us shaken like this, now should be their best chance...」

593:t_024:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
($$リディ・マーセナス$$... That earnest heart of his hurts others and himself... If he would just calm down and look around...)

593:t_024:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(The world is wide... So many people are resonating with each other...)

593:t_024:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(I learned that from Master and everyone on the $$ガランシェール$$ team... and from $$バナージ$$...)

593:t_024:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. Feel it through the $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$.」

593:t_024:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Everyone on the $$ガランシェール$$ team...!」

593:t_025:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I can feel it too...」

593:t_026:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$! $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_026:3.en:
$$ベッソン$$
「It gives me chills to think what would've happened if we'd been left drifting in space like that.」

593:t_026:4.en:
$$フラスト$$
「Ha! No way I'm dying in a place like this! Right, Captain!」

593:t_026:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Yeah! I'm going to survive, no matter what, until I see $$マリーダ$$ in her wedding dress!」

593:t_026:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Never giving up, whatever happens... A true sailor, Captain $$ジンネマン$$.」

593:t_027:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Gh...! What is this feeling!」

593:t_027:3.en:
$n
「So Miss $$スズネ$$ is surfacing inside $$アムブリエル$$!」

593:t_027:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...Tch...! Now a nuisance like that shows up too!」

593:t_028:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's stop this, Ensign $$リディ$$!」

593:t_028:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up, $$バナージ$$! A kid like you, flattered as a $$ニュータイプ$$, throwing everything into chaos!」

593:t_028:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ニュータイプ$$...! A subspecies of humanity that embodies the curse of $$ラプラスの箱$$...! Somebody has to be the human sacrifice to quell it!」

593:t_028:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$マーセナス家$$ that left the curse behind, and the $$ビスト家$$ that kept hiding it...!」

593:t_028:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Only we, who each inherit one of them, can settle this feud!」

593:t_028:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「It wasn't supposed to be like this...! That was never a curse, it was a prayer! If only $$ニュータイプ$$s had never been born!」

593:t_028:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Calm down, $$リディ$$! The machine is swallowing you up!」

593:t_028:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「So what?! I'm out to defeat a new humanity that is trying to evolve! Selling my soul to a machine is nothing...!」

593:t_028:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$! Open your heart more!」

593:t_028:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't you understand, Ensign $$リディ$$?!」

593:t_028:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're a $$ニュータイプ$$ too! The light of the $$バンシィ$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ is coming from inside you!」

593:t_029:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are drawn to those who emit $$脳量子波$$. Perhaps it was your strong feelings that called them.」

593:t_029:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「And you have the power to master that $$バンシィ$$.」

593:t_029:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You must be able to hear it! Everyone is worried about you! $$オードリー$$, Ensign $$ミヒロ$$ and the others too!」

593:t_029:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Then I won't use words... But even so... even so...!)

593:t_029:8.en:
$n
(Ensign, you always made time for my special training. Let me repay you for that!)

593:t_029:9.en:
$$キラ$$
(For Her Highness $$ミネバ$$, you were ready to throw away your own life and fight. You're the same as us...!)

593:t_029:10.en:
$$エマ$$
(Where did you go, the you who tried to prove yourself without relying on the $$マーセナス家$$?!)

593:t_029:11.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
(A pilot lives by his own skill alone! Family, blood, to hell with all that!)
